source_facts: The echo-cancel module exposes capture/source and sink/playback stream topology.
The WebRTC SPA AEC backend is an available/default echo-cancel engine surface.
The playback/render signal and microphone/capture signal are both inputs to echo cancellation rather than denoising being treated as echo cancellation.
AEC3 analyzes/stores the far-end render stream and processes the near-end capture stream to remove echo.
WebRTC AudioProcessing models reverse/render and primary/capture streams explicitly.

sources.note: Target distro/package/runtime version must be measured on clay-direct-dev rather than inferred from upstream release state.
GitHub is a convenience mirror; canonical latest-source identity should be resolved from the upstream Xiph source before target execution.

source_facts: Real-time speech enhancement/noise suppression is the project role.
A PipeWire/LADSPA integration path is documented.
The documented operating sample rate is 48 kHz.
